On the first two tours the song was the opening song, while during the residency show and on the last two tours it was featured in the encore. It was also the opening song of her "Shania Twain Live", "Winter Break" and "Up! Live in Chicago" live video albums, as well as on her headline on the Super Bowl XXXVII halftime show. The song was also performed by "American Idol" winner Carrie Underwood during the fourth season. The song was featured in a 2005 episode of "America's Funniest Home Videos"
